name: toolkit
description: A Claude Code toolkit built for real production work across architecture, Node.js backends, security, code quality, and AI engineering.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Base layer: setup, sync, the rules-loader hook, cove (fact-checking), judge (four-lens review), and cleanup.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend basics and API design samples that are not tied to a framework. Suited to learning and simple endpoint work; reach for node when building production NestJS backends.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Turns a spec into architecture: contracts, a data model, tasks ordered in waves, and parallel implementation.

plugins.name: node
plugins.description: Production flows for NestJS backends: requirements, tasks that respect the architecture, implementation, review, tests, runtime, TypeScript, and reliability.

plugins.name: reviewer
plugins.description: Builds an MR review pipeline tailored to the project under .reviewer/ (init, sync, add-agent, review).

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security coverage: a read-only audit, OWASP Top 10 review, and the security-reviewer agent.

plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: AI engineering support: specialist agents covering architecture, agents, RAG, evals, and security, plus skills on LLM patterns, prompting, context engineering, tools, MCP, provider integration, resilience, observability, and evals.
